headline: Iraq's Financial Situation Does Not Allow It to Finance an Alternative Export Pipeline System
summary: Iraq is seeking alternative export outlets and pipelines because of the Strait of Hormuz crisis, but a report says the strait will remain its main artery. Oil exports make up 90% of its budget.
why: Oil exports make up most of Iraq's government revenue, so export route constraints affect its fiscal position and crude supply.
